events.title: New Feature: The Map
events.summary: We're updating this demo for your enjoyment,You can now press M on your keyboard or Y on controller to access a Map. You can also click the map button on the left part of the screen. The map reveals previously traveled areas. If you already have a save, you will need to travel to this area to have it populated in the map. events.title: Paradox Tower Demo releases TODAY
events.summary: The Demo for Paradox Tower releases today! Paradox Tower is a deterministic resource management RPG. If you know the name "Magic Tower", you know what I'm talking about. If you don't know it, please try it! You might get a new addiction. The game follows Eternia, the witch and Bubu the cat, across a multi-floor tower, fighting monsters, demons and witches!
